name: Portfolio Building Plan
description: Builds a plan for creating a freelance or professional portfolio including content selection criteria, portfolio structure, case study format, and a 30-60-90 day publishing schedule. Produces a complete portfolio development plan document. Use when the user wants to build a professional portfolio, create a freelance portfolio website, select work samples, or plan a portfolio launch for career advancement or client acquisition. Do NOT use for personal brand strategy (use personal-brand-strategy), resume writing (use resume-bullet-writer), or website development (use web development skills).
